changelog: Back closes search first, then one CS3M page, without navigating CloudStream behind the settings.
Supported hosts show gesture progress with the previous settings hub; cancelling restores the current page.
Keyboard, debug, inspector and live-editor overlays consume Back before the screen underneath.
Exit confirmation yields to non-home navigation and foreground overlays instead of swallowing their Back handling.
Some quiet traces still wait to be found.
message: v729 - correct Back navigation and cancellable gesture previews
